svg.title: Heart disease model comparison
svg.desc: Animated chart: 60 held-out patients are scored by three models in turn. Logistic Regression with C=1 gets 52 right, with C=0.1 it gets 54, and XGBoost gets 51 after scoring 100% on its training data. Bars compare train and test accuracy.

g.text: 237 patients to train on, 60 held out
less fit on train, better on new patients
